scenes.tts: Sonic hedgehog patterns the bottom of the tube. What tells the top of the tube it is the top?
scenes.visual: Title card: The Top of the Tube. The map, with the roof plate and epidermis highlighted.
scenes.narration: Sonic hedgehog patterns the bottom of the tube. What tells the top of the tube it is the top?

scenes.tts: Recall neural induction. In frog animal caps, blocking B M P let the cells become neural.
scenes.caption: Recall neural induction. In frog animal caps, blocking BMP let the cells become neural.
scenes.visual: A small piece of frog ectoderm, labelled frog animal cap; BMP is blocked and its cells turn neural. Small note: in chick, BMP inhibition alone is not enough.
scenes.narration: Recall neural induction. In frog animal caps, blocking BMP let the cells become neural.

scenes.tts: Now, inside the tube, B M P comes back. It arrives from the skin and from the roof plate.
scenes.caption: Now, inside the tube, BMP comes back. It arrives from the skin and from the roof plate.
scenes.visual: The transverse neural tube map, dorsal up: notochord below, floor plate at the bottom, ventricular zone around the central canal, roof plate at the top, epidermis over it. Blue BMP fades down from the epidermis and roof plate.
scenes.narration: Now, inside the tube, BMP comes back. It arrives from the skin and from the roof plate.

scenes.tts: B M Ps, bone morphogenetic proteins, act through receptor kinases and Smad proteins.
scenes.caption: BMPs, bone morphogenetic proteins, act through receptor kinases and Smad proteins.
scenes.visual: A BMP dimer bound by two type I and two type II receptor kinase chains; activated Smads join Smad4 and carry the message to the nucleus.
scenes.narration: BMPs, bone morphogenetic proteins, act through receptor kinases and Smad proteins.

scenes.tts: In nineteen ninety-five, Karel Liem, Thomas Jessell and colleagues tested them on chick neural plate explants.
scenes.caption: In 1995, Karel Liem, Thomas Jessell and colleagues tested them on chick neural plate explants.
scenes.visual: Credit: Liem, Tremml, Roelink and Jessell, 1995. Explants in dishes.
scenes.narration: In 1995, Karel Liem, Thomas Jessell and colleagues tested them on chick neural plate explants.

scenes.tts: B M P four and B M P seven could mimic the dorsalizing effect of epidermis.
scenes.caption: BMP4 and BMP7 could mimic the dorsalizing effect of epidermis.
scenes.visual: One dish with epidermis, one with BMP4 or BMP7; both explants turn dorsal blue.
scenes.narration: BMP4 and BMP7 could mimic the dorsalizing effect of epidermis.

scenes.tts: In nineteen ninety-seven, they proposed that B M Ps from the epidermis induce the roof plate.
scenes.caption: In 1997, they proposed that BMPs from the epidermis induce the roof plate.
scenes.visual: Credit: Liem, Tremml and Jessell, 1997. An arrow from epidermis to the roof plate.
scenes.narration: In 1997, they proposed that BMPs from the epidermis induce the roof plate.

scenes.tts: The roof plate then becomes a second source of related signals.
scenes.visual: The transverse neural tube map, dorsal up: notochord below, floor plate at the bottom, ventricular zone around the central canal, roof plate at the top, epidermis over it. The roof plate itself begins to glow blue.
scenes.narration: The roof plate then becomes a second source of related signals.

scenes.tts: It also makes wints, including wint one and wint three A.
scenes.caption: It also makes Wnts, including Wnt1 and Wnt3a.
scenes.visual: Labels beside the roof plate: Wnt1, Wnt3a.
scenes.narration: It also makes Wnts, including Wnt1 and Wnt3a.

scenes.tts: The dorsal tube makes six early classes of interneurons. They are named D I one to D I six, from the top down.
scenes.caption: The dorsal tube makes six early classes of interneurons. They are named dI1 to dI6, from the top down.
scenes.visual: The transverse neural tube map, dorsal up: notochord below, floor plate at the bottom, ventricular zone around the central canal, roof plate at the top, epidermis over it. Six dorsal stripes appear from the top down, labelled dI1 to dI6.
scenes.narration: The dorsal tube makes six early classes of interneurons. They are named dI1 to dI6, from the top down.

scenes.tts: Predict. Remove the roof plate early in a mouse, leaving the floor plate and notochord untouched. Which classes are lost?
scenes.visual: The roof plate is erased from the map. Question on screen: which classes are lost?
scenes.narration: Predict. Remove the roof plate early in a mouse, leaving the floor plate and notochord untouched. Which classes are lost?

scenes.tts: In two thousand, Kevin Lee, Paula Dietrich and Thomas Jessell removed the roof plate genetically.
scenes.caption: In 2000, Kevin Lee, Paula Dietrich and Thomas Jessell removed the roof plate genetically.
scenes.visual: Credit: Lee, Dietrich and Jessell, 2000. A mouse spinal cord section with no roof plate.
scenes.narration: In 2000, Kevin Lee, Paula Dietrich and Thomas Jessell removed the roof plate genetically.

scenes.tts: The three dorsal-most classes later failed to form. The classes further down did not depend on it, in that experiment.
scenes.visual: Stripes dI1, dI2 and dI3 fade away; dI4 to dI6 remain.
scenes.narration: The three dorsal-most classes later failed to form. The classes further down did not depend on it, in that experiment.

scenes.tts: The two systems also oppose each other. B M P signaling alters the response to Sonic hedgehog.
scenes.caption: The two systems also oppose each other. BMP signaling alters the response to Sonic hedgehog.
scenes.visual: Gold from below and blue from above push against each other in the middle of the wall.
scenes.narration: The two systems also oppose each other. BMP signaling alters the response to Sonic hedgehog.

scenes.tts: So the wall sits between a signal from below and one from above. Cells in the middle can be shaped by both.
scenes.visual: One mid-wall cell highlighted, with the gold slope from below and the blue slope from above both reaching it.
scenes.narration: So the wall sits between a signal from below and one from above. Cells in the middle can be shaped by both.

scenes.tts: This lesson follows the ventral code in full and the dorsal one in outline.
scenes.visual: The ventral stripes drawn in full detail; the dorsal stripes sketched in outline.
scenes.narration: This lesson follows the ventral code in full and the dorsal one in outline.

scenes.tts: Now the whole rule. The neighbours supply a slope. The progenitors draw the lines.
scenes.visual: Rule card: the neighbours supply a slope; the progenitors draw the lines.
scenes.narration: Now the whole rule. The neighbours supply a slope. The progenitors draw the lines.

scenes.tts: Signals from below and above set the level. The cells read it, and how long it lasts, and answer with a combination of factors.
scenes.visual: The transverse neural tube map, dorsal up: notochord below, floor plate at the bottom, ventricular zone around the central canal, roof plate at the top, epidermis over it. Both slopes fill the wall; a dial and a clock feed into an address label of factors.
scenes.narration: Signals from below and above set the level. The cells read it, and how long it lasts, and answer with a combination of factors.

scenes.tts: In the ventral tube, pairs of neighbouring factors repress each other. That helps each cell settle on one identity and hold it, though a lasting change in signaling can still move it.
scenes.visual: Blocking arrow pairs on each ventral border; the lines turn crisp.
scenes.narration: In the ventral tube, pairs of neighbouring factors repress each other. That helps each cell settle on one identity and hold it, though a lasting change in signaling can still move it.

scenes.tts: Keep the limits too. Sharp is not the same as accurate. The signal shapes its own slope. And the floor plate follows partly different rules.
scenes.visual: Three limit tags under the rule card: sharp is not accurate; the signal shapes its slope; the floor plate is a special case.
scenes.narration: Keep the limits too. Sharp is not the same as accurate. The signal shapes its own slope. And the floor plate follows partly different rules.

scenes.tts: One more role waits. Later, the same floor plate becomes a target for growing axons.
scenes.visual: The floor plate glows; axons from the dorsal cord begin to grow toward it.
scenes.narration: One more role waits. Later, the same floor plate becomes a target for growing axons.

scenes.tts: The takeaway: two slopes, read by the cells, become the map of the spinal cord.
scenes.visual: The transverse neural tube map, dorsal up: notochord below, floor plate at the bottom, ventricular zone around the central canal, roof plate at the top, epidermis over it. Every stripe is filled, dorsal and ventral. Takeaway on screen.
scenes.narration: The takeaway: two slopes, read by the cells, become the map of the spinal cord.
